title: Roguelette: Roguelike Roulette Deckbuilder ༼ つ ◕_◕ ༽つ <3.
author: Life-Heron-6533
selftext:
My goal with my project "Roguelette" was to see how far i can push AI and what are the limitations. Im still working on the project but i will soon release a play test.

  
What the game is essentially about:

1. Build a Deck of strong balls
2. Modify Balls by applying Artifacts
3. Fuse Balls to make them stronger
4. Get Unique Cards to enhance you synergy power
5. Collect Unique Relicts to unlock strong new playstyles and benfits
6. Spin the Wheel let the ball cascade. Use consumables to enhance you outcome
7. Strike the Enemy and clear the Demon realm from the evil intruders

Steam page here, wishlist make me smile :D [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4864990/Roguelette/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4864990/Roguelette/)

comments.author: MisterBlackStar
comments.body: Can you dig deeper on how you used the AI?

replies.author: Life-Heron-6533
replies.body:
I generally used AI for coding, assets and music. Ofcourse i also used a lot of manual handcraft to push the assets in the right art style direction / consistentency and make them work for the game.

\- Simply used a coding AI like (opus, codex, kimi).

\- Music i mainly used suno

\- Assets i created complex workflows in comfyui, which are a bit hard to explain :D

comments.author: CubeUnleashed
comments.body: looks fresh, would you share your biggest take aways in working with AI on this project?

replies.author: Life-Heron-6533
replies.body:
I think my biggest key take away is that you often have to take what you get and not what you want. Ofcourse you can always get the right directions, but if you generate an asset by text it will never be as u imagined. That is in my opinion the biggest limitation. 

In german we say: Ein Bild sagt mehr als tausend Worte.

That simply means a image can discribe more then thousand words. And simply what i want to say is you can not discribe something with text that can mean a thousand different words and meanings. Its simply text as input is very weak to translate into an image

comments.author: Pricklepants
comments.body: Game looked great in a previous post already! Could you go in a little detail on how you tackled the UI? Got to a decent point in development but as right now UI is nonexistent. Did you start with image generation to get the look and feel down before coding or what’s the best practice? Would love some insights!

replies.author: Life-Heron-6533
replies.body:
My UI is also not Perfect it really depends on your game. Especially heavy text based UI as my are hard to handle. You can create a UI based on code only as you highly likely have right now. The problem is that you highly likely don't have an imagination about how your UI should look like. If you dont know how your UI should look like you canno't guide the AI to make it.

I would recommend you look at other games how they made their UI and make your own version of it.
